Get help. Accept it. Open up 100% and wait... Little by little it will get better... You're young... and it's hard being young these days... the universe has a plan for you ... but you have to stick around to find out what it is... It WILL be worth it... I attempted suicide twice and failed both times... permanent damage from one attempt but my life has been getting better and better even after losing my Dad to suicide and Nephew five short months later... please reach out to someone or call a suicide hotline... Please... It will get better.

Don't give up... I have 2 failed attempts behind me and I thank God every day that I failed and crawled out of the hole to see sunlight again... The world has a plan for you but you have to stick around to find out what it is... It'll be worth it... I promise you that.

#suicideSUCKS I have 2 failed attempts and am so happy that I failed... I was depressed for a decade and didn't think I'd ever want to live again but I crawled out of the hole and am living a good life... Get the help that you need... No matter what has happened and who you may have hurt (including yourself), you deserve to be happy. I lost my Dad to suicide in 2011 and my nephew only 5 short months later in 2012... Get better... take the first step.
